In log view, / opens Command; ordinary typing opens Compose.
Enter sends by default; [input] send_mode=review adds a review step.
Esc leaves an editor/reader; in Review it restores the draft; in the log it backgrounds.
Use signals is off by default: Ctrl-C/Ctrl-Z cancel a draft, not the program; Ctrl-D is inert.
[input] use_signals=false is the default; true enables tty Ctrl-C/Ctrl-Z signals.
Tab completes. Command Up recalls accepted commands; Compose arrows edit.
Start with /connect irc.example.org, then /join #channel.
/saveconf remembers your settings; next launch, /connect reuses them.
Optional guided setup: /quickstart or /panel.
Optional hotkeys: /bindings, /bind KEY ACTION, /unbind KEY|all; none by default.
Help: /help ls lists topics; /help COMMAND explains a command.
Session controls use job numbers from --sessions, not process IDs.
Locale fallback: LC_ALL, LC_MESSAGES, LANG; IRC commands stay in English.
